title: Maiorana--McFarland separation for four bent-partition constructions
summary: For each construction in Sections III-VI of the source, determine whether its bent partitions generate a bent function outside the ordinary Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: For each source construction family $s\in\{\mathrm{III},\mathrm{IV},\mathrm{V},\mathrm{VI}\}$, let $\mathcal C_s$ be the family of bent partitions produced by that section. Decide whether some $\Gamma\in\mathcal C_s$ generates a bent function outside the ordinary Maiorana--McFarland class. A positive decision for $s$ requires a generated function together with a rigorous non-membership certificate; a negative decision requires a proof that every bent function generated by every $\Gamma\in\mathcal C_s$ remains in the class. Settle all four values of $s$.

scope.domain: Bent partitions and p-ary bent functions generated by the source's four construction families
assumptions: The bent partitions are obtained from the constructions in Sections III, IV, V, or VI of the source
Generated bent functions and ordinary Maiorana--McFarland membership use the source conventions
parameters: s: source section in {III, IV, V, VI}
scope.unresolved_remainder: All four construction families remain unresolved independently: the Section III direct-sum family, the Section IV generalized-Maiorana--McFarland/preimage family, the Section V generalized Wang--Fu--Wei family, and the Section VI LP-packing lifting family. Later sigma and association-scheme results do not provide the required ordinary-class separation certificates.
